'''Bellfruit''' was a sour [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. It was served at the [[Feast of Prosperity/Legends|Feast of Prosperity]] event on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. The fruit was [[Color/Legends|colored]] green and purple.<ref name="Cooking" />
